summary: An inline page-level banner for the outcome of a page action (saved, sent, failed), bound to a state object; renders nothing for null.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: The outcome to show (texts translated). Each new object is a new message and takes focus.

inputs.name: dismissLabel
inputs.description: The close button's accessible name (translated); without it there is no close button.

inputs.name: moveFocus
inputs.description: Move focus to the banner whenever a new state arrives.

outputs.name: dismissed
outputs.description: The close button was pressed; the caller sets state to null.

a11y: role=alert for an error and role=status for success and info; labelled by its title when it has one. The banner is focusable (tabindex=-1) and receives focus on each new state so keyboard and screen-reader users land on the outcome. Icons are decorative; logical CSS mirrors in RTL.
